description: Search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty and search intent for up to 100 keywords in one $0.04 call (Google Ads data via DataForSEO Labs). Use when you already have a keyword list to prioritise. volume = avg monthly searches, cpc in USD, competition 0-1, difficulty 0-100. Keywords without data are left out of results and listed in missing (still charged). Bad input is free; upstream errors are not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or country name, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

includeMonthly.description: Add each keyword's monthly search volumes.

keywords.description: Keywords to look up (1-100; each at most 80 characters). Whitespace and control characters are normalised to single spaces and keywords to lower case; a keyword that is then empty, over 10 words or over 80 characters is not looked up and is listed in missing, and a request with no keyword left to look up is a free 400 (the one exception to openverbs schema compatibility).

languageCode.description: Language code (2-letter). Default en. An unsupported location falls back to 2840 (United States) with en (or the requested language if the United States offers it); a supported location with a language it does not offer uses that location's default language (en if offered). Either way market.fallback is true and market.warnings says what was used.

locationCode.description: DataForSEO location code. Default 2840 (United States); an unsupported code falls back to 2840 (United States).

name: keyword_overview
title: Keyword overview (up to 100 keywords)
